name: Madelise Palace Hotel & Spa
detail: The hotel has just been renovated and upgraded, so the facilities are still new, the rooms are spacious, clean, and comfortable. The space is airy, and the room size is good compared to many other hotels. It is definitely worth choosing for your stay. I recommend everyone to experience it!

name: Palette Ngoc Ha Luxury Residence
detail: A worthwhile choice with a clean space, full amenities, and well-cared rooms. The bathroom is tidy, Wi-Fi works well, and transportation is quite convenient. The staff is friendly and very helpful, providing a comfortable stay experience. The location is fairly decent, although not the most convenient.

name: Townhouse Starlake Residence
detail: The room is clean, airy, new, and odor-free, but the location is a bit inconvenient for my commute to work. The staff here are enthusiastic in assisting customers, welcoming guests, and providing quick support.
area: Tu Liem District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Quang Ba Trade Union Hotel
detail: - The hotel seems to have been built a long time ago but is clean, well-equipped, and the staff are professional and enthusiastic. I booked a room urgently at midnight through the app and sent an email to the hotel requesting confirmation of my booking, which they promptly responded to the next morning. I really appreciate the professionalism of the hotel. - The hotel has a beautiful and airy view of West Lake; the spacious yard is suitable for receiving and parking cars; there are many green trees providing a cool environment. The breakfast is not too diverse, but I found it acceptable. - During my stay, there were many foreign guests at the hotel, and the staff could communicate in basic English. Overall, I was very pleased with my experience here. If I have the opportunity, I will visit again.
area: Tay Ho District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Delica Premium Hotel
detail: Excellent location, right in the old quarter of Hanoi, you can walk to Hoan Kiem Lake and nearby snack shops. The room is clean and tidy, and the air conditioning is very effective; it's quiet for sleeping. Breakfast is served on the first floor from 7 to 9 AM, with simple and tasty options. The front desk staff are friendly, communication is smooth, and they patiently help resolve any issues. Overall, it's very cost-effective, perfect for a short overnight stay, and I will choose to stay again next time I come to Hanoi. Highly recommended!

name: Hanoi Sail Hotel
detail: The hotel is located a little away from the busy street, but it's easy to reach by Grab bike. I was initially worried about the safety since it is located in a back alley, but there were no problems at all. The room was very clean, and the building itself was new and beautiful. The staff were very kind to me, who doesn't speak much English, and I felt a warm hospitality, making it the best three-night stay. On the first night, the room didn't have a window, which made me feel a bit cramped, so I requested to change rooms, and they gladly accommodated me. On the final day, after checking out, they stored my luggage until the evening, and the breakfast was delicious and very satisfying. I was a bit concerned since it was a very cheap accommodation, but I would like to stay here again next time. Thank you very much!
area: Hoan Kiem District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Luxury Backpackers
detail: The kindness and responsiveness of the staff: Above all, the staff's response is outstanding, especially Linh, who is very kind and friendly. Linh always greeted us with a smile and was attentive to our inquiries about accommodations as well as travel advice. Thanks to her, the entire hostel felt warm and welcoming. There are also staff who speak Japanese, which is a great comfort for those concerned about language barriers. Great location: The hotel is within walking distance of Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Cathedral, and the Old Quarter, making it very convenient for sightseeing. There are many shops and restaurants that convey a local atmosphere nearby, making it an ideal place for exploring the city. It is situated at a midpoint between Hanoi Station and Hoan Kiem Lake, offering easy access wherever you want to go. Clean and comfortable dormitory: The dormitory rooms are clean and cozy, each bed equipped with an electric fan, keeping the room cool and comfortable. The beds are spacious, with large shelves for storing luggage and secured lockers, ensuring safety. Additionally, air conditioning works well, and Wi-Fi is reliable, allowing for a comfortable stay during your travels. Balance of facilities and price: Despite the affordable prices, the dorms are well-equipped with air conditioning, hot showers, and clean, comfortable bedrooms, offering excellent cost performance. Especially for backpackers, the balance of comfort and affordability is well-maintained, providing great satisfaction. Convenient access: The hotel is close to major tourist attractions in Hanoi and easy to access by public transport or taxi. The surrounding facilities are well-developed, making movement very smooth. Overall, the location, facilities, and staff responsiveness all receive very high marks, making it a highly recommended lodging for solo travelers and tourists alike.
area: Hoan Kiem District,Hanoi - View on map

name: BH Riverside Hotel
detail: The room is just as shown in the pictures, very spacious, clean, and the staff are friendly and polite. The nearby area is a local community, very quiet, and you might occasionally hear the sound of chickens, but it doesn’t have a major impact, making it easy to sleep. The water flow in the shower is a bit small, which is the only downside. The location is in the city center; it takes about 15 minutes to walk to the southern bank of Hoan Kiem Lake, but to reach some popular tourist areas, like the cathedral, it takes about a 30-minute walk. You will pass a busy road, and when crossing the road, you might need to make eye contact with drivers to safely and quickly get across. Of course, you can also take a taxi, which is very convenient, but this area can have some traffic jams. Overall, this is a hotel worth recommending with affordable prices, which you wouldn’t find in tourist-heavy areas at this rate.
area: Hoan Kiem District,Hanoi - View on map

name: Kecho Legacy Hotel & Spa
detail: I booked a good-ranked, spacious room, but since it's not a famous foreign chain hotel, there were a few inconveniences. The bathroom had high humidity and was stuffy and hot. The water was lukewarm, almost like hot water. The air conditioner didn't work well during the day and was hot (maybe because three sides have windows?). I only received one card key, which was inconvenient. The room had a slightly unpleasant smell, and the pillow had a strange odor. Other than that, there were no issues! Although you can't stop a taxi right in front, the location is great, and the hospitality from the staff was truly excellent! Breakfast was stylish, colorful, and beautifully presented, which made me happy. There is a trendy and famous café nearby. When checking in, they asked for my return flight time, and since I had an early morning flight, they prepared a packed breakfast for me as a takeaway. I was very grateful for their kindness.

name: Madelise Hanoi View Hotel
detail: This hotel has a great location, convenient transportation, a clean environment, and the rooms are very well maintained in terms of cleanliness and facilities. The staff is warm and attentive, ensuring a comfortable stay. The sleep quality is good, and the hot water supply is stable, making guests feel relaxed and at ease. Overall, it offers excellent value for money and comes highly recommended.
